caption: The drawing depicts a small house-shaped structure with a steep blue roof, two chimneys, and a red exterior with white trimming. The front of the house is open, showing the interior. The open door on the right side is white with a rounded top window and four small rectangular panes. Inside the structure, the walls have a yellow background with a repeated black quatrefoil pattern. There is a figure of a man standing at a counter inside the house. The man is dressed in brown pants and a brown jacket, with a white shirt and red tie, and has a mustache and brown hair. The floor inside is colored in shades of blue and red. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a close-up illustration of the door with a sign above it that reads "NOVELTY BANK." The sign is blue with white lettering and a red arch above the door. The drawing is signed "Alf Bruset" at the bottom right.
title: Novelty Bank
